items.feeHint: Flea net value uses the simple fee rate entered here for planning. It may differ from the in-game listing fee.
items.valueHelp: Reference value is the higher of estimated flea net and trader buy price; value per slot divides it by the inventory slots the item occupies.

gunsmith.title: Detailed Gunsmith modding guide
gunsmith.description: Choose a Gunsmith task and follow the base-weapon, required-part, and final-condition steps in order.
gunsmith.empty: No Gunsmith build objectives are available.
gunsmith.prepareWeapon: Open the preset editor for {weapon} and review its current configuration.
gunsmith.installPart: Install {part} in a compatible slot on the {weapon} preset.
gunsmith.installPartWithAdapter: {part} does not attach directly to {weapon}. Use the preset editor to connect the appropriate adapter or intermediate part first.
gunsmith.compatible: Compatible with a direct weapon slot
gunsmith.adapterPathFound: Installation path with intermediate parts found
gunsmith.noStructuralCandidate: No directly compatible candidate was found for the structured requirements.
gunsmith.conditionsIntro: After installing every part, confirm that the weapon preset satisfies these values.
gunsmith.finalCheck: Check the folded state, magazine, chamber, and durability before handing the weapon to Mechanic.
gunsmith.structuralComplete: A directly compatible option is available for every required part and category.
gunsmith.structuralPartial: Some requirements need an adapter or intermediate part that must be confirmed in the in-game preset editor.
gunsmith.guideNote: A category may allow several valid combinations. If the selected part conflicts with another slot, choose an alternative and use the final values shown in the in-game preset editor.
gunsmith.relatedLink: Find the quest for this build

ammo.title: Ammo penetration chart
ammo.description: Compare verified API ballistics and transparent penetration grades for armor classes 1–6.
ammo.method: Cells are performance grades, not exact first-shot probabilities. They compare penetration power to class × 10; real results vary with armor durability and current game formulas.
ammo.pinnedNote: {count} pinned rounds always stay at the top of the filtered results.
ammo.pinLimit: Up to {max} rounds can be pinned. Unpin one before pinning another.
ammo.empty: No ammo matches the current filters.

about.title: About TarkovDex
about.intro: TarkovDex is an unofficial information service that organizes scattered Escape from Tarkov data for faster searching and comparison. Its goal is to present the prices, quests, maps, and boss information players check repeatedly in one clear, dependable reference.
about.itemsBody: Search instantly by item name and compare 24-hour averages, daily lows and highs, recent price movement, and vendor sell values.
about.tasksBody: Search by quest name or filter by trader and map to find the mission and requirements you need without scanning the full list.
about.mapsBody: Review player counts, raid durations, boss lineups, and spawn chances for each map in either PvP or PvE mode.
about.newsBody: Official Steam patch notes and events are collected automatically and made available in readable Korean and Simplified Chinese.
about.economyBody: Craft input cost, output value, profit, ROI, and hourly profit are ranked within each station.
about.combatBody: Ammo ballistics and class 1–6 penetration performance are shown without inventing unverified probabilities.
about.armorBody: Compare armor class, protected body areas, movement / ergonomics penalties, and compatible plates.
about.dataBody: Game data and original news posts come from public external sources and refresh on a regular schedule. TarkovDex extracts the details needed for practical search and comparison instead of exposing raw datasets, and isolates temporary upstream failures so the rest of the site remains usable.
about.gameDataValue: Public static JSON API from json.tarkov.dev
about.newsDataValue: Official Escape from Tarkov Steam news feed
about.refreshValue: Game data about every 6 hours · news about every hour
about.supportValue: PvP and PvE · 한국어·简体中文·English
about.principlesBody: TarkovDex prioritizes readable information architecture, consistent search behavior, and clear sourcing over decorative excess. The same information stays in familiar locations when switching game modes or languages.
about.disclaimerBody: TarkovDex is not affiliated with or endorsed by Battlestate Games. Names, images, and game assets related to Escape from Tarkov belong to their respective rights holders. External data may differ from the live game following updates or changes at the source.
